articlesServed.title: Articles Served
articlesServed.description: Source-record IDs of every Knowledge article already served this session, one per line. Use the literal text 'none' if no articles were served yet — never an empty string, which the platform's invocable-action layer treats as a missing required value.

intentSummary.title: Intent Summary
intentSummary.description: Short summary of what the user was trying to accomplish.

queueHint.title: Queue Hint
queueHint.description: Billing, Technical, or General. Ignored and overridden to LegalTrust when the reason code is security_keyword or gdpr_request.

reasonCode.title: Reason Code
reasonCode.description: Which deterministic trigger fired: human_request, security_keyword, gdpr_request, transactional_intent, account_specific, unresolved_after_3_turns, or no_confident_answer.

sessionId.title: Session Id
sessionId.description: The Ask Nimbus conversation session id. Idempotency key.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.description: The full conversation transcript so far.
